utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli—I’ll keep adding every repair to the list today, and we’ll sort the order by the mailboxes tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Gus—that keeps it tidy. Tomorrow morning by the mailboxes, we’ll set the order and hand out the jobs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Right, I’ll keep the list updated today so we’re ready to sort everything first thing tomorrow by the mailboxes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still telling everyone about the repair drive and saying the garage this weekend unless we hear otherwise, Dane. If anyone asks for firm availability or tool details, Faye’s the one to check with.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Vik—Rosa said the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, so maybe we should start telling folks that instead and check with Faye on the tool details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—I’ll start telling everyone it’s Sunday at the community center instead, and I’ll keep sending people to Faye for the tool details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. Sunday works for me—just send the final details when you have them, and I’ll bring what fence hardware and tools I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Uli—that’s a big help. I’ll send you the final details tomorrow as soon as they’re confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, thanks, Rosa. I’ll keep Sunday open and bring what I can once you send the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Latest I’ve got is tape and nails are in decent shape, but I’m still checking on cords and gloves for you, and we could use extra tarps if anyone has them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps—I’d only been hearing it second-hand, so I’ll pass along that cords, gloves, and tarps are the big gaps right now. If you do confirm who’s bringing what before the weekend, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do—I’m keeping the list tight, and once I confirm the cords and gloves before the weekend, I’ll send you the update.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Leo, the latest I’m hearing is the repair drive’s Sunday at the community center—Mrs. Calder’s already dropped off spare tools, Ben’s bringing lumber after lunch, and we’re still looking for a few people who can handle roof patching and fence posts.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—Sunday at the community center works for me. What time are you starting, and do you want me on roof patching or fence posts?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard a start time yet, Leo, but if you’re game I’d put you on fence posts for now since that’s one of the spots we’re still short on.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Eight are confirmed so far, and I’m checking back with that maybe-couple by tomorrow so we can lock them in fast.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—keep that follow-up tight and tell me by tomorrow how many are firm, not just likely.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do—I’ll follow up with them tomorrow and give you a firm count as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to plan around school drop-off and pickup—late morning, around 10:30, usually works best for me. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 10:30 is still the best bet from what I’ve heard, though they’re still pinning down the repair list and a couple details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—if 10:30 holds, I can plan around school pickup just fine. Once the repair list’s set, send it over so I know what to prep for.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, thanks for checking in. I think 10:30 still sounds right, but are we still meeting by the garage this weekend or did that change?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Still the garage this weekend—10:30 is what I’ve got in my notes, and I’m keeping you down as the point person for confirmed availability and tool details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—okay, thanks, I’ll stick with the garage at 10:30 then and double-check the tool details so I can confirm availability once I’ve got it straight.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, Hana—check with Faye first, and just send me anything firm on the repair drive while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Will do—I’ll check with Faye on availability, pickups, and tool coverage first, and I’ll only send you something once it’s firm.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks—I'm still out running errands, so just keep me posted if Faye confirms anything firm.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Sam—I’ll sort the donated tools first and make you a quick list of anything we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara—that helps a lot. Once you’ve got the list, bring it by and I’ll match it against the repair stations.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Good, just shoot me the list when Ira lands the time and spot, and I’ll fold Cleo’s supply check into it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do—I’ll keep it brief and send the full list as soon as Ira confirms the time and spot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — once it lands, I’ll skim it and plug Cleo’s numbers in so we can keep this moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I’m still happy to help—I just need a quick reminder what we’re collecting for the repair drive again.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We’re collecting repairable donations, but before we promise anyone anything I need the pickup drivers, exact hours, and storage address nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Pia. I can still help once Mara confirms the hours and storage address; I just don’t want to mix up the details again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right—sorry, I’m blanking again, but I think it was still by the garage at 10:30 unless that changed?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep, still 10:30 by the garage for now—I’m just waiting on the last few neighbors before I send the final repair list around.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh good, thanks—I keep losing track, so I’ll stick with 10:30 by the garage unless you hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m on board in principle, Opal, but I still need the pickup drivers, the exact hours, and the storage address confirmed before we promise anyone anything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve still got the repair drive at the garage this weekend, Pia, but for firm availability, hours, and tool details I’ve got Faye marked as the one to confirm with before we promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, but I still need Faye to pin down the pickup drivers, exact hours, and storage address before I can promise anyone anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa—I’ll pass along that it’s Sunday at the community center. I’m still only hearing second-hand that we’re gathering basic repair supplies and spare tools, so I’ll point folks to you unless Mara confirms the final list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Nell—please keep sending supply questions my way for now, and I’ll check with Mara so we can share one confirmed list with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good, Rosa—I’ll keep it simple and send any supply questions your way until Mara confirms the final list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, we’re still going ahead—I’m confirming the tools and volunteer count tonight so we can lock things down tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good to hear. What I’ve heard is 10:30 still seems like the best bet, and once you lock the repair list and the last couple details, I can pass it along quietly.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That lines up with what I’m hearing too—if 10:30 still holds after I finish confirming tools and volunteers tonight, I’ll send you the final details tomorrow so you can pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the counts on tape, gloves, nails, and a few toolkits pretty solid now; if you hear of anyone with spare tarps or fence hardware, that’s the gap I’m watching.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — I’m already spreading the word and collecting repair requests this week, so I’ll ask around for spare tarps and fence hardware too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That helps a lot, Mara—if anyone mentions extra work gloves too, send them my way and I’ll keep the list up to date.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking before I say anything firm, Leo—Faye should be the one to confirm the Sunday timing, pickups, and tool coverage for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—I’ll wait for Faye to confirm Sunday timing, pickups, and tool coverage. Once she does, I can help sort what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo—that helps. Once Faye confirms the hours, pickups, and tool coverage, we can sort the repair list in order.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik—that’s exactly what we need; keep spreading the word, send setup or check-in volunteers my way, and point tool questions to Rosa and timing to Faye.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it, Sam—I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, send any setup or check-in volunteers your way, and point tool questions to Rosa and timing to Faye.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, Vik—that takes a lot off my plate, so just keep me posted if any volunteers come through.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Ira, the repair drive’s on Sunday at the community center, and I’m still trying to round up a few more folks for roof patching and fence posts.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s good to know, Tess—Sunday at the community center helps. I’m still out on errands, so if you get anything firmer on volunteers or supplies, keep me posted, alright?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Ira—I’ve heard Mrs. Calder already dropped off spare tools, and Ben’s bringing lumber after lunch, but we’re still short a few hands for roof patching and fence posts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Kira, let’s keep it straightforward: today we finish one clear list of every repair, and tomorrow morning by the mailboxes we sort the urgent ones and assign jobs.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but are we definitely confirmed for this weekend, Eli? I still need someone to verify the tools, volunteers, and where everything’s being stored before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, this weekend still works, Kira—tools are coming in, and today we’re just confirming the list, supplies, volunteers, and storage spot so tomorrow morning we can set the order cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mina, the repair drive’s moving ahead by the mailboxes tomorrow morning, and we’re mainly gathering basic tools, gloves, tape, nails, tarps, and fence hardware.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus, how many households are confirmed for tomorrow morning, and what’s still not covered that I can take off your plate?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’ve got a solid handful confirmed so far, and the biggest gaps are extra tarps, a couple more toolkits, and someone to help sort supplies when folks arrive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Faye—last I heard Rosa moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, so what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks for the update—Sunday can work if I can stay around school pickup, so I mainly need the timing and a quick list of what still needs doing before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m late to the details too, but Rosa said Sunday at the community center, so I’ll check on the timing and what supplies or urgent fixes are still on the list and send it over.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—thanks, Uli. I’ll bring whatever fence screws and brackets I can find by the shed, and if I forget the toolbox again, just point me where I’m useful.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren—meet me by the garage this weekend, and bring the screws and brackets first. If the toolbox slips your mind again, you can help sort what comes in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—by the garage this weekend, screws and brackets first. If I wander over empty-handed, just set me to sorting and I’ll make myself useful.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m alright with that as long as Quinn or Jules confirms the pickup coverage, hours, and the exact shed address by the mailboxes before tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s fair, Pia — let’s have Quinn confirm pickup coverage and hours today, and we’ll use the shed by the mailboxes on Alder Lane for storage before we meet tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Alright, that helps — once Quinn confirms the pickup coverage and hours today, I’m comfortable sticking with the plan for tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Cleo—last I heard it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’m following up with volunteers today; where do you need me to jump in?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Glad you’re here—can you keep chasing tarps and fence hardware today? I’ve got a decent count on tape, nails, gloves, and a few toolkits, but those are still the big gaps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll keep chasing tarps and fence hardware today and let you know as soon as I get anything firm.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, Sunday at the community center is the latest plan. If you can still do the tool drop-off then, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, thanks for catching me. I can still do the tool drop-off Sunday at the community center, unless that shifts again.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I’ll let you know if Rosa confirms any last-minute change, but for now Sunday at the community center still stands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands, Leo, so if you get anything firm on the repair drive—start time or where it’s set up—send it my way, alright?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do—I’m double-checking the start time and setup spot now, and I’ll send you the details as soon as they’re firm.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo—I’m still out, so just send me the firm time and setup spot once you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s right, Oren—by the garage, and we’re collecting tools plus spare fence hardware. I’m confirming the volunteer count tonight so we can lock everything in tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—good, thanks for reminding me, Jules. I left my toolbox by the shed again, but I can bring it over and help with the tools and fence hardware.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be a big help, Oren—thanks. If you bring the toolbox by the garage, I’ll fold you into the volunteer count when I confirm everything tonight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ve heard Sunday at the community center, but I’m still waiting on Faye to confirm the hours, pickups, and tool coverage before I call it firm.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That’s still where I’m at with it, Nell—once Faye confirms the hours and pickup details, I’ll pass along anything firm.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What I’ve heard is 10:30 is still the best bet, but they’re still locking in the repair list and a couple details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s not actually confirmed yet, then? I need a straight yes on the tools, volunteers, and storage before I count on this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, not fully confirmed yet — 10:30’s still the best bet, but I’d wait for Quinn to lock in the tools, volunteers, and storage before counting on this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Vik, the repair drive’s still on for tomorrow by the mailboxes, and I’m lining up tools and volunteers now. If you’ve got a spare drill or sawhorses, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—I’ll keep telling everyone about the repair drive and say it’s by the mailboxes tomorrow, and I’ll mention you’re lining up tools and volunteers now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Vik—that helps a ton. If anyone asks, tell them we’re still especially looking for extra tarps, fence hardware, and a couple more sturdy tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That timing should work for me if we keep it around 10:30 after drop-off, and I’ll keep track of who’s confirmed once you send the availability and tool list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ve still got the repair drive at the garage this weekend, so I’ll send you the availability and tool list and keep you marked as the point for confirmed availability and tool details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — once you send that over, I’ll line it up around the 10:30 window and keep an eye on confirmations around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sam, the latest I’m hearing is it’s Sunday at the community center—Mrs. Calder’s already dropped off spare tools, Ben’s bringing lumber after lunch, and we’re still trying to round up a few more folks for roof patching and fence posts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That helps a lot, Tess—let’s keep pushing for a couple more hands on roof patching and fence posts, and I’ll check with Faye to firm up the timing before I send anything definite around.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good—if Faye confirms the timing, I’ll keep spreading the word and see if I can shake loose a couple more folks for roof patching and fence posts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Bo, just so you have the latest, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m making sure everyone has the updated details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Good, Sunday at the community center—I'll pass that along and have Cleo keep an eye on whether we still need extra tarps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo—that helps a lot. Please have Cleo send me any tarp updates, and I’ll keep everyone aligned as we get Sunday organized.
